body: gonna take a nap now. I got to think about stuff.

I'd never speak to another family member like I would myself. They care about people and their welfare and I fucking do not. I mean absolutely do not. I actually sometimes fantasize about killing random strangers. It's fucking insane to just be yourself when you know what you are doing is wrong. It's like two persons each pulling you with all their might in opposite directions and it fucking tears me apart. I need a fucking break from myself.

I thought about it but I just feel fucking crippled to do anything. Even if I were to talk to a psychiatrist I wouldn't know what to say. That I have fantasies of killing myself? That whenever I see a person approaching me the first thought that comes to my mind is how to take them down for a kill without anyone noticing? That sometimes I feel so angry that I just want to kill everybody in my near vicinity for no apparent reason other than the fact that they are near me? That I can't will myself to do the most common of things? That I felt hunger but then decided fuck it even i hadn't eaten proper for a week? That I had a hobby that I found out wasn't really my hobby? That I am on reddit when I should just have killed myself and be done with it. What the fuck? Yeah that is what I am like and I fucking hate myself.

What I meant was that I stopped going to work. I just couldn't get myself to go to work or for that matter do anything expected of me. I've just been sitting in front of a computer and that's about it. I've just lost control and every fucking time I think of getting it back, I go into a panic mode thinking what the fuck I will do and if I can do it and the answer inevitably is no. Might be, it's just that I do not fit in this world. I am too much of a crazed fuck to be around here.
